questions.reason: The verbose query parameter schema reads "type: boolean / default: false / title: Verbose", so `false` is the documented default and no other option is defensible.
"Managed MLflow in Nebius AI Cloud enables you to access model artifacts, training results and tuned hyperparameters in a single interface" is exactly option b.
"A typical split is: **80–90%** of examples → training * **10–20%** of examples → validation" matches option c only.

"SecretStash allows you to avoid hardcoding sensitive data, for example, in Terraform manifests or cloud-init scripts. As a result, you eliminate vulnerabilities and maintain compliance with security."
"`learning_rate` (float, optional) Step size for gradient descent ... Typical values: `1e-6`–`5e-5`"; the other ranges in the options belong to n_epochs, lora_r and warmup_ratio.
Inference logs are "automatically collected chat completions generated via API or Playground" and "**Filtered Datasets:** datasets created from inference logs using sql queries."
"**Inference Logs:** automatically collected chat completions generated via API or Playground (unless Zero Data Retention is enabled)"; uploaded and filtered datasets are listed as separate types.
"The VM or private network doesn't need to accept inbound connections from the internet for this traffic", because "The agent opens an outbound TLS connection to a regional Nebius edge endpoint."
Key fields to watch: "`status`: `validating_files` → `queued` → `running` → `succeeded` / `failed`", so validating_files is first.
"Run the Nebius AI Cloud Docker credential helper. It lets you use registries in Container Registry without running the `docker login`." (`nebius registry configure-helper`).

"If the object is less than 100 MB, it makes a single `GetObject` request to the source bucket and a single `PutObject` request to the destination bucket"; multipart is documented only for larger objects.

"Minimum replicas are reserved and non-preemptible and remain allocated ... for as long as the endpoint is active" versus "Scaling above minimum replicas depends on available burst capacity and is not guaranteed indefinitely."
RerankResult > relevance_score is "Relevance score of the document"; total_tokens belongs to RerankUsage and embedding/owned_by to other endpoints.

All four excerpts are verbatim; "Reranks documents based on their relevance to a query" is the ranking step, while embeddings take "Input text to embed" and chat completions "Create a model response for the given chat conversation."

"If you share a capacity block group between a Soperator cluster and an inference node group, you can move GPU capacity between them without stopping the entire Soperator cluster" — and the same steps apply to separate clusters, which rules out option a.
Step "Download file contents" calls `curl "https://api.tokenfactory.nebius.com/v1/files/<file_ID>/content"`, while `GET /v1/files/<file_ID>` is the separate "Inspect file metadata" step.
EmbeddingRequest lists "required: - model - input"; encoding_format defaults to float and dimensions is optional/nullable in the same schema.

The only cited excerpt is "When you delete an endpoint, Serverless AI automatically deletes its VM and container (boot) disk"; the captured endpoints page never states what stopping does, so the correct option's claim that stopping leaves the VM in place "uncharged for compute" is not established by the evidence.
Under the heading "## AI Application Frameworks" the page lists Llama-Index and Langchain, while Postman, Helicone and Tavily appear under Developer Tools, Observability and Agentic Search.
"The container exposes an OpenAI-compatible `/v1/chat/completions` API."
Model card: "**Quality** — MMLU score reported by the model provider"; the distractors are the separate price and tokens-per-second fields.
"This bucket is not deleted automatically after you delete the cluster. You are still charged for the bucket until you delete it", which also rules out the "free of charge" option.
"View them on the **Metrics** tab of your job or endpoint; the underlying VMs aren't shown in Compute."
The quickstart prerequisites require being in "a group that has the `admin` role within your tenant or project; for example, the default `admins` group."

"Minimum replicas are reserved and non-preemptible and remain allocated to your deployment for as long as the endpoint is active"; the SLA section ("do not include a formal SLA unless covered by contract") rules out option d.
"Min replicas are guaranteed while active. If you stop the endpoint the reservation will be freed up", alongside "Minimum replicas are always allocated while the endpoint is active."
"User and service accounts of different regions cannot access the secret" — stated separately from the permissions condition, so option b is wrong.
Automatic charging lists exactly "At the start of the month, if your balance is negative" and "When the configured billing threshold is reached".
"`sentry`: Continuous recording with auto-upload (useful for large-scale evaluation)", against base (no recording), highlight (ring buffer) and dagger (human-in-the-loop).
The control-plane cURL examples all send `-H "Authorization: Bearer $API_TOKEN"`; routing_key and endpoint_id are identifiers, not credentials.
EmbeddingRequest > dimensions: "The dimensions to use for the request" (examples 4096, 8192), while encoding_format only chooses float or base64.
"Download LoRA adapter weights of the fine-tuning job. They are stored as files in the `output` directory, in the `fine-tuning-axolotl` bucket."

"Nebius Tunnels secures the transport between the tunnel agent and Nebius edge, but it doesn't add user authentication or authorization to your application." The other options name documented benefits of tunnels.
"When an endpoint stops, its GPU capacity is released back to the shared pool. This applies regardless of why the endpoint stopped", including "stopped for scheduled or emergency maintenance".

"This fingerprint represents the backend configuration that the model runs with. Can be used in conjunction with the `seed` request parameter to understand when backend changes have been made that might impact determinism."
"Choose whether to save filesystem changes before submitting an operation. Every operation starts fresh compute, regardless of that choice."
"If a job, endpoint or Devlab created from a custom image fails ... Serverless AI deletes the underlying virtual machine (VM) and boot disk to avoid costs."
Comparison table: "Pricing | Per GPU/hour, billed with per-minute granularity | Per token".
RerankRequest lists "required: - model - query - documents"; user and service_tier are optional in the same schema.

"Serverless AI deletes the underlying virtual machine (VM) and boot disk to avoid costs ... To keep the VM alive for debugging, run the deployment with a \"sleep-on-fail\" wrapper."

"nodes in different GPU clusters cannot communicate over InfiniBand™ even if they use the same fabric infrastructure", because each cluster gets a unique P-Key.
GPUDirect RDMA "allows data to flow directly between each GPU and its NIC, avoiding CPU, thus boosting the data exchange speed."
"if you select `fabric-7`, you can only add NVIDIA® H200 NVLink with Intel Sapphire Rapids to this cluster" — the fabric constrains the GPU platform.

"Set the required network or subnet when you create Nebius AI Cloud resources. You cannot move a resource to another network or subnet after creation."

"For a security group to apply to a VM, you need to add a VM's network interface to the security group."
"`.spec.priority`: Priority of the rule. 1 is the highest priority, 1000 is the lowest."
"Local SSD disks are ephemeral, meaning temporary: their data is erased when the VM is stopped or deleted."
"One shared filesystem can be attached to multiple VMs at once", while "One Compute network SSD disk can only be added to one running VM at a time."
For Network SSD Non-replicated disks, "The size of each namespace is 93 GiB, so the disk size must be a multiple of 93 GiB."
"All VMs that the filesystem is attached to must belong to the same project. Sharing a filesystem across projects is not supported, even if the projects are in the same region."
"Being on the tenant user list does not grant access to resources. Each account should be assigned to a group that specifies the level of access."

"A service account belongs to the project where it was created, but its access to resources is defined by the groups that it's added to ... can be granted access to any resource in the tenant regardless of the project."
